scripts.test:detached:
turbo run build && light test-validator && (trap 'light test-validator --stop' SIGINT; (anchor test --skip-local-validator -- --features=testing || true) && echo '
🚀 Validator still running. Use "light test-validator --stop" to stop it.
'; while true; do sleep 1; done)
scripts.test:
turbo run build && light test-validator && (anchor test --skip-local-validator -- --features=testing; code=$?; light test-validator --stop && (if [ $code -eq 0 ]; then echo "
⚠️ Don't forget to recompile the .so file before deployment
"; else echo "
❌ Tests failed with exit code $code
"; fi); exit $code)
